output: html_notebook

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load data

```{r}
df_loss <- 
  read_rds("../data_out/df_fu_analysis.rds") %>% 
  filter(age_loss <= 20.5) %>%  # Get rid of unwanted comparison groups
  mutate(age_loss = age_loss - mean(age_loss, na.rm = T))
  
round(range((df_loss$age_loss)))
```

Calculate between effect

```{r}
df_loss$between_age_loss <- ave(df_loss$age_loss, df_loss$fam_link, FUN=mean)
```

Fit GLM

```{r}
fit_glm <- 
  glm(is_anypsy_anytime_all~between_age_loss + age_loss,
      family="binomial",
      data=df_loss)

fit_glm_natural <- 
  glm(is_anypsy_anytime_all~between_age_loss + age_loss,
      family="binomial",
      data=df_loss %>% filter(unnatural_death == 0))

fit_glm_unnatural <- 
  glm(is_anypsy_anytime_all~between_age_loss + age_loss,
      family="binomial",
      data=df_loss %>% filter(unnatural_death == 1))
```

Standardized average treatment effect

```{r}
fit_std <- stdReg::stdGlm(fit_glm,
                          data = df_loss,
                          X = "age_loss",
                          x = seq(-14, 29, 1),
                          cluster = "fam_link")

fit_std_unnatural <- stdReg::stdGlm(fit_glm_unnatural,
                                    data = df_loss %>% filter(unnatural_death == 1),
                                    X = "age_loss",
                                    x = seq(-14, 29, 1),
                                    cluster = "fam_link")

fit_std_natural <- stdReg::stdGlm(fit_glm_natural,
                                  data = df_loss %>% filter(unnatural_death == 0),
                                  X = "age_loss",
                                  x = seq(-14, 29, 1),
                                  cluster = "fam_link")
```

Extract estimates

```{r}
df_std_summ <-
  summary(fit_std, 
          transform = "odds",
          contrast = "ratio",
          reference = 18 - mean(df_loss$age_loss, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  pluck("est.table") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(death = "All deaths") %>% 
  bind_rows(summary(fit_std_unnatural, 
                    transform = "odds",
                    contrast = "ratio",
                    reference = 18 - mean(df_loss$age_loss, na.rm = T)) %>% 
            pluck("est.table") %>% 
            as_tibble() %>%
            mutate(death = "Sudden")) %>% 
  bind_rows(summary(fit_std_natural, 
                    transform = "odds",
                    contrast = "ratio",
                    reference = 18 - mean(df_loss$age_loss, na.rm = T)) %>% 
            pluck("est.table") %>% 
            as_tibble() %>%
            mutate(death = "Not sudden")) %>% 
  mutate(age_cat = rep(seq(-14, 29, 1),3) + mean(df_loss$age_loss, na.rm = T))
```

Plot

```{r}
df_std_summ %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_cat, 
             y = Estimate,
             ymin = `lower 0.95` - 0.025,
             ymax = `upper 0.95` + 0.025,
             color = death, fill = death)) +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 1/4, color =NA, alpha = 0.3, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = death)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red2", linetype = 2) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = 18, alpha = .3, linewidth = 20) +
  # annotate("text", x = 18, y = 5, label = "Reference age group",
           # angle = 270, size = 4) +
  # facet_wrap(~outc, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 18, by = 2),
                     # labels = c(seq(0, 16, by = 2), "18-20"),
                     limits = c(0, 18)) +
  labs(x = "Age at parental loss", y = "Odds ratio",
       fill = "Cause of parental deaths",
       color = "Cause of parental deaths") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.9, 4.5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
